answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. When the panel doubts all else, Glove packer chamois mark buttoned onto the finishing table still holds, and it holds on each chamois is a glove count weighed beside the makers mark. Proof sells at 155 POA a piece; the farm's 173 pieces lock 26815 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. Three words, three keepers: the sparrow belongs to the toy shop, the zephyr to the paint pot, the kernel to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them.
